name: HoverEspimon
main_effect:
[On Play] [When Digivolving] Reveal the top card of your opponent's security stack. If that card is a Digimon card, gain 1 memory. If that card is a non-Digimon, ＜Draw 1＞. Place the revealed card on the top or bottom of your opponent's security stack face down.
[All Turns] While there's a Tamer, this Digimon gains ＜Blocker＞ (This Digimon can block in the blocker timing.) and can't be deleted by your opponent's effects.
